items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Do not approve new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align and infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. AI cost records also conflict: $881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls. Continue only the existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation work; do not create duplicate telemetry or finance work.

Minimum measurement required before any financial return claim: period-aligned attributable revenue by tracking ID, site, and content; reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, and experiment costs; a single authoritative AI-cost ledger; and a defined learning outcome with exposure and incremental cost. Until then, treat margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift as unknown. Traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items, performance scores, and AI usage are not financial returns.
